note: Adam's garage in his white bungalow on Jasenova (S02 plot in the middle). The model painted the garage from a closer camera than the sketch: the open door (2.2 m) spans y 265-790, ~234 px per metre at the front wall, horizon y ~280; the wall meets the floor at y ~795. The workbench (radio, multimeter, enamel pot of screws, pegboard and shelf above) stands along the left side wall reaching towards the camera, the wooden chair with Adam's service bag right of it in the foreground (feet y ~1000-1035), the open sectional door in the front wall (daylight: driveway, grey slat fence and sliding gate, the street, a white house and yellow birches across), the tall grey cabinet of small-parts drawers with the fuse drawer pulled out right of the door, metal shelving, boxes, a hanging bicycle and winter tyres at the right edge. Walkable = the open concrete floor between the chair and the shelving (sun patch); the chair is an occluder (its right post and legs, not the bag, so the bag never shows over Adam after G01).

S01.tools.reason: Adam's brown leather service bag (repainted from olive canvas to match the TOOLS icon and the bag he carries, M5-04, art/tools/s01_bag_recolor.py) on the seat of the wooden chair in front of the workbench

S01.fuse.reason: tall grey cabinet of small-parts drawers right of the door, the fuse drawer pulled out; staging pass 2026-10-05 (M5-04 / PT-S06 rule, all actions): the hero stands left of it and reaches sideways, so it stays visible while he uses it
